summary: Full backend + frontend end-to-end testing of FitCoach. 22/22 backend pytest tests pass (auth via Bearer & Cookie, 401 unauth, focus set/validate, trainers, bookings CRUD + 409 duplicate, progress CRUD, workouts plan+session, Gemini food analyze with real macros, Gemini vision body scan). Full frontend flow verified via Playwright on the production preview host: /dashboard auth gate redirects to /login, seeded cookie session_token=test_session_fitcoach_1 hydrates the app, sidebar renders, focus-specific nav gating verified for muscle_fat / nutrition / strength (each unlocks a DIFFERENT feature set), and Booking, Progress, Workouts, AI Food Track (real Gemini result) and AI Body Scan (real Gemini vision result 'Mesomorph' with description, training_focus, nutrition_focus, recommended_split) all work through the UI.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 470-line file. Consider splitting into modules (auth, bookings, progress, workouts, ai) as feature set grows. Not blocking.
get_current_user prefers cookie over Bearer header. Works fine, but if a client sends BOTH the cookie is used silently. Acceptable but worth documenting.
AI endpoints have no server-side rate limiting; abusive calls could burn Gemini quota. Consider a light per-user throttle if this ships to real users.

/api/food/analyze and /api/bodyscan/analyze return raw AI JSON without a strict Pydantic response model; malformed AI output would surface as 502 (already handled via try/except), but if you want strong contracts a response_model would help.
test_credentials: Seeded session token: test_session_fitcoach_1 for user_id=user_testfitcoach1 (email test.fit@example.com, focus muscle_fat). Auth: Emergent Google OAuth.
seed_data_creation: Used already-seeded MongoDB user + session in test_database. During testing several TEST_* rows were created (bookings, progress entries, workout sessions, food logs, body scans) — non-destructive to real data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL comes from frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Seed session token 'test_session_fitcoach_1' is valid until 2026-07-26; re-seed via the snippet in /app/memory/test_credentials.md if it lapses. For browser tests the reliable way to hydrate the session is context.add_cookies with the `url` param (not `domain`) — that ensures httpOnly/secure/sameSite=None is applied correctly for fitness-dashboard-115.preview.emergentagent.com and the app's /api/auth/me returns 200. The BodyScan file input is hidden (display:none) — use page.locator + set_input_files instead of wait_for_selector(visible=true).
